title: Veterans Pension Net Worth — Months Over Which Care Is Counted
content:
# Ongoing or ended care in Veterans Pension net worth

The care figure for Veterans Pension net worth is counted over a number of months, judged on the care months reported in the 3 whole months before the redetermination and on the gap between the end of the most recent care month and the date its report reached VA; the ongoing-care gap is 92 days.

| At least 3 care months reported | Most recent care month | Status | Monthly figure counted |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | ended no more than 92 days before its report reached VA, or ended after it | ongoing | 12 times |
| yes | ended more than 92 days before its report reached VA | ended | once for each care month reported |
| no | — | — | once |

### Boundary pairs (hypothetical, three care months reported)

- Ended March 31, report received July 1: 92 days — ongoing, 12 times.
- Ended March 31, report received July 2: 93 days — ended, 3 times.
- Ended April 30, report received April 20: ended after receipt — ongoing, 12 times.
